content:
Track: Introduction to Data Engineering
    - Lesson 1: Overview of Data Engineering and its importance
    - Lesson 2: Basic Concepts in Data Management and Storage
    - Lesson 3: Working with Databases: Understanding SQLite
    - Lesson 4: Structured Query Language (SQL) Basics
    - Lesson 5: Advanced SQL: Joins, Aggregations, and Subqueries
    - Lesson 6: Data Modeling and Database Design
    - Lesson 7: Introduction to ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) Processes
    - Lesson 8: Practical Application of ETL using SQLite

   Track: Python for Data Engineering
    - Lesson 1: Setting up Python Development Environment
    - Lesson 2: Working with CSV and Excel Files in Python
    - Lesson 3: Introduction to Pandas Library
    - Lesson 4: Advanced Data Manipulation using Pandas
    - Lesson 5: Data Cleaning Techniques
    - Lesson 6: Data Transformation using Python and Pandas
    - Lesson 7: Working with NumPy and SciPy Libraries for Mathematical Operations
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Databases in Python using SQLite3 or SQLAlchemy

   Track: Data Structures and Algorithms
    - Lesson 1: Understanding Data Structures (Lists, Tuples, Dictionaries, Sets)
    - Lesson 2: Sorting Algorithms (Bubble Sort, Selection Sort, Quick Sort, Merge Sort)
    - Lesson 3: Searching Algorithms (Linear Search, Binary Search)
    - Lesson 4: Big O Notation and Complexity Analysis
    - Lesson 5: Introduction to Data Structures for Efficient Storage (Trees, Graphs)
    - Lesson 6: Algorithmic Design Techniques (Divide and Conquer, Greedy Approach)
    - Lesson 7: Advanced Sorting and Searching Techniques
    - Lesson 8: Time and Space Complexity Optimization Techniques

   Track: Data Wrangling and Preprocessing
    - Lesson 1: Handling Missing Values in Datasets
    - Lesson 2: Outlier Detection and Removal
    - Lesson 3: Normalizing and Standardizing Data
    - Lesson 4: Feature Engineering Techniques
    - Lesson 5: One-Hot Encoding, Label Encoding, and Binary Encoding
    - Lesson 6: Scaling Data (Min-Max Scaling, Z-Score Normalization)
    - Lesson 7: Text Preprocessing for NLP Tasks
    - Lesson 8: Creating a Feature Set and Preparing the Data for Modeling

   Track: Data Pipelining and Stream Processing
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Apache Kafka and its components
    - Lesson 2: Setting up a Kafka Environment
    - Lesson 3: Producing and Consuming messages with Kafka
    - Lesson 4: Real-time Data Processing using Stream Processing Frameworks (Apache Storm, Apache Flink)
    - Lesson 5: Building a simple data pipeline using Kafka and Apache Flink
    - Lesson 6: Handling Failures and Error Recovery in Data Pipelines
    - Lesson 7: Monitoring and Optimizing Data Pipelines for Performance
    - Lesson 8: Deploying and Scaling a Data Pipeline on Cloud Platforms (AWS Kinesis, Google Pub/Sub)

   Track: Introduction to Apache Hadoop and Big Data Technologies
    - Lesson 1: Overview of Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS)
    - Lesson 2: Understanding MapReduce and its architecture
    - Lesson 3: Writing MapReduce Jobs for simple data processing tasks
    - Lesson 4: Introduction to Apache Spark and its components
    - Lesson 5: Using Spark SQL, DataFrames, and DataSets for structured data processing
    - Lesson 6: Building ETL pipelines using Apache NiFi or Apache Beam
    - Lesson 7: Optimizing performance in Big Data Processing Tasks
    - Lesson 8: Scaling and Deploying Big Data Applications on Cloud Platforms (AWS EMR, Google Dataproc)
